credentials.label: Personal Kilo Gateway API key

setupSteps.title: Find your existing personal key
setupSteps.description: Open Your Profile on the personal account and copy the Gateway API key privately into lain. The documented key lives at the bottom of that page.

setupSteps.title: Confirm a current concrete free model
setupSteps.description: The 2026-10-25 public models endpoint lists liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b:free. Confirm the exact ID and review data handling; the previous Gemma free ID is absent from this observation. Do not substitute paid or auto routes.

setupSteps.title: Keep the exhausted account unchanged
setupSteps.description: No purchase, credit top-up, auto top-up, BYOK or paid fallback is part of this setup. A rejected request leaves the live check open; it does not authorize another billing route.
